_note: Which model writes each page type. model and effort are the writer's, used for the first draft, the retries and the claims review. block_rewrite, when set, is the model and effort that rewrite a field carrying a BLOCK (the hybrid: a cheap writer, a stronger model on what fails). judge is the rubric reviewer in quality-review.js. reviews writes the Google review reply drafts (reviews/draft.js, 8 Nov 2026). images writes the alt text of a photo added by hand on the Images tab, from a small copy of the photo (images/alt.js, 13 Nov 2026).
